about.description: NVDAX is a single-stock perpetual listed on Kraken, tracking NVIDIA Corp., margined and cash-settled in USD. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Kraken prices this market off the Backed xStock token for NVIDIA Corp., a tokenized representation of the listed shares rather than the shares themselves. Funding settles every 1h. Up to 20× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
